title: Violet Quest
description: A vanilla-style questing mod for Minecraft 1.21.1
body:
# Violet Quest

A vanilla-style questing mod for Minecraft 1.21.1, compatible with both Fabric and NeoForge.

## Overview

Violet Quest adds a comprehensive quest system to Minecraft with a vanilla-styled GUI. Players can view, track, and complete quests through an intuitive interface featuring pan and zoom capabilities, visual quest connections, and interactive quest nodes.

## Features

- **Quest System**: Complete quest management with serialization and network synchronization
- **Interactive GUI**: Vanilla-styled quest screen with pan/zoom functionality
- **Quest Connections**: Visual representation of quest dependencies and progression
- **Multi-Platform**: Works on both Fabric and NeoForge using Architectury API
- **Client-Server Sync**: Full synchronization of quest states between client and server
